_comment: Optional Touhou Little Maid integration: maids refresh civilization presence nearby.
If the mod is not installed, the entity id is unknown and this file is skipped with a warning.
Radius uses the same built-in defaults as vanilla examples in defaults.json (3/3/1 half-extents
in voxel chunks when radius_voxel_chunks is omitted). Change x/z/y on an entry to widen or narrow the halo.
